name: Barbatos
source:
Mostly sunbathes in the garden naked with only a white sheet around him when he is out of battle.

Once in a while, he tries to go to battle naked because he likes the sun, but his subordinates dissuaded him with their lives and we have yet to hear that he appeared in battle naked.
